subject: SET statement
notes: kb/Work PB449. Both sentences - 'Identifier-7 shall reference a data item of category program-pointer. Identifier-8 shall be of category program-pointer.' - are now asked on EVERY statement whose receiving list contains a program-pointer, because Format 9 is selected from that list instead of from receivers[0]-or-the-sender. Before: SET WS-N PP1 TO WS-M has two identifier operands, so Format 9 matched syntactically and is the only format whose receiving operand may be a program-pointer, yet neither t0 nor s0 was a program-pointer, the re-route never fired, and the statement compiled clean and aborted at run time. The identifier-8 half additionally now covers a sender that is not a reference at all (a literal or an arithmetic expression), which previously returned BoundUnsupported from an unreachable arm.
